title: CyLab Security Academy: Self-Paced CTF Learning
summary: Carnegie Mellon University's free CTF learning platform, continuing the former picoCTF learning service. Topic- and difficulty-organized challenges and curated learning paths introduce computing and security concepts, including web security.
defensive_use: Use the provider's deliberately constructed exercises to learn security concepts and explain the assumptions behind a result. Treat challenge completion as practice, then connect observations to secure design and bounded evidence.
prerequisites: The publisher states that no experience is needed.

access.note: The official site states that the learning platform is free. Login and sign-up links are provided; account creation, eligibility, and signed-in challenge access were not tested.

published.note: Original publication date is not stated on the reviewed resource pages.

source_displayed.note: No resource-page publication or revision date is displayed; review time is not a publication date.

freshness.note: Current official learning pages and the dated platform-transition notice were reviewed. The notice records May 8, 2026 and an August 23, 2026 update; neither dates the original curriculum. No exercises were run.

sources.title: picoctf.org is now CyLab Security Academy

caveats: Practice stays within the provider's assigned exercises and current rules; this listing grants no authorization for other systems.
The May 8, 2026 platform-transition announcement is not the original publication date of the learning material.
